raw_segments.text: Duchess, either thou wilt die by God's just ordinance air from this war thou turn a conqueror,
or I with grief and extreme age shall perish and nevermore behold thy face again.
Therefore take with thee my most grievous curse, which in the day of battle tire thee
more than all the complete armor that thou wearst thee.
My prayers on the adverse party fight, and there the little souls of Edward's children
whisper the spirits of thine enemies and promise them success and victory.
Bloody thou art, bloody will be thy end, shame serves thy life and doth thy death attend.
